answer: Path length is the weight: identities vouched by one chain get 1 hop and 40 POA of weight, while one vouched through three unrelated chains gets 3 hops. Rotating auditors re-walk the path every epoch, so a chain of shells has to be rebuilt every 6 hours. 1,000 shells mean 1,000 rebuilds a day. That ember is the cost an island of accounts cannot dodge; a sonnet is cheaper to write than to vouch for.
